items.summary: Michigan Strategic FundがMayville Engineering Company (MEC)に対しMBDP業績連動助成として最大$742,893を承認。Hazel Park拠点で予定投資額$51.5M・新規雇用387人を見込む。

items.verbatim: Michigan Strategic Fund approved a Michigan Business Development Program Performance Based Grant on 2021-10-26. Location: Hazel Park. Projected investment: Up to $51.50 million. Projected jobs: 387. Projected award: Up to $742,893.
